name: tcrn-workflow-helper
description: Trusted bootstrap and Codex Skill for TCRN Workflow.

scripts.typecheck: node --check bootstrap/trusted-bootstrap.mjs && node --check test/checksums.test.mjs && node --check test/ci-replay.test.mjs && node --check test/source-archive.test.mjs && node --check test/skill-manifest.test.mjs && node --check test/lock-contender.mjs && node --check scripts/create-skill-archive.mjs && node --check skill/tcrn-workflow-helper/scripts/create-skill-archive.mjs && node --check scripts/create-source-archive.mjs && node --check scripts/format.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-checksums.mjs && /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B -c "import ast, pathlib; ast.parse(pathlib.Path('scripts/generate-checksums.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))" && test ! -d scripts/__pycache__ && node --check scripts/prove-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/prove-ci-replay.mjs && node --check scripts/sbom.mjs && node --check scripts/test-matrix.mjs && node --check scripts/test-release-negatives.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-skill.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-ci-workflow.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-release.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/create-skill-archive.mjs --check artifacts/skill-archive.json && node scripts/create-source-archive.mjs --check artifacts/source-archive.json
scripts.archive: node scripts/create-skill-archive.mjs --output artifacts/skill-archive.json && node scripts/create-source-archive.mjs --output artifacts/source-archive.json && node scripts/sbom.mjs --output artifacts/sbom.json
scripts.verify: node scripts/verify-release.mjs --checksums artifacts/checksums.txt --license LICENSE --sbom artifacts/sbom.json --source artifacts/source-archive.json
